caption: The drawing depicts a full-length side view of a standing figure mounted on a rectangular wooden platform. The figure is dressed in a dark blue dress with a skirt that has pink and white feather-like shapes around the hips and a green sash draped diagonally from the shoulder to the waist, where it is secured with a yellow belt. The lower edge of the skirt is trimmed with light blue or gray fringe. The individual’s legs are painted yellow, with a black vertical stripe running down the outer side of the right leg, and the feet are clad in dark shoes with light-colored soles. The figure's arms are extended forward, palms up, and the hands are light brown. The head is adorned with a large headpiece featuring four feathers in pink, white, and gray, which are attached to a white band that wraps around the figure’s head and over long, black hair. The figure has a brown complexion, and the facial features are rendered in detail, including the eyes, nose, and mouth. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Wooden Indian
